keyrock.label: Keyrock: 16,000+ unlocks across 40 tokens
keyrock.finding: About 90% of unlocks were followed by price pressure, starting about 30 days before. Team unlocks were worst (about -25%), investor and community unlocks moderate, ecosystem-development unlocks averaged +1.18%. Bigger unlocks hit harder; linear releases disrupt less than cliffs. Keyrock is a market maker and has not published its data.
